extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology; worker-5 automated pending labels were replaced with source-located evidence classes without overclaiming molecular target closure.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SYTOX Green uptake assays support plasma membrane permeabilization by MsDef1, MtDef4, and selected variants/peptides; MtDef4 shows stronger concentration-dependent permeabilization than MsDef1, but permeabilization is not sufficient to explain all antifungal potency differences.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: MsDef1, MtDef4, MsDef1-gamma4, MsDef1-R38Q, GMA1-C, GMA4-C, GMA4-L variants against Fusarium graminearum PH-1 hyphae
mechanism_claims.limitations: Permeabilization is source-supported as a direct membrane readout, but the paper explicitly indicates it does not solely determine antifungal activity or define a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Growth inhibition and variant/peptide comparisons support the gamma-core motif, especially the cationic/hydrophobic MtDef4 loop residues, as a major structure-activity determinant for antifungal potency.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: MsDef1/MtDef4 gamma-core substitutions and synthetic gamma-core peptides in Table 1 and Figures 2, 5, 6, and 7
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is structure-activity/phenotype evidence; it does not directly identify a receptor or molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MsDef1 has a morphogenic hyphal phenotype while MtDef4 and MsDef1-gamma4 are nonmorphogenic; Delta Fggcs1 resistance context supports different action pathways for MsDef1 and MtDef4/MsDef1-gamma4 without resolving a direct molecular target.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Fusarium graminearum PH-1 and Delta Fggcs1 phenotypes under MsDef1, MtDef4, and MsDef1-gamma4 treatment
mechanism_claims.limitations: Resistance/morphology phenotypes support pathway differences but are not direct receptor-binding evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Homology models and sequence comparisons locate alpha-core and gamma-core motifs in the defensin fold, supporting structural interpretation of activity determinants as inferred mechanism context.
